entry.summary: No Smartraveller page and no current Tuvalu government page found. Secondary sites agree on a visitor permit on arrival for about one month with an onward ticket; they disagree on the fee (free or A$100 cash) and on extensions.
entry.next_check: Ask the Tuvalu High Commission or the Immigration Department in Funafuti about the fee and extensions.

seasons-and-flow.notes: Two distinct seasons. Visitor flow (peak and quiet months) is still to be read from the tourism authority's statistics.

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: January, March and December. Driest: June, September and October. Hottest: May (28.9°C average). Coolest: July (28.4°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.
